tool.run/totp/b9f34c0b40bd.text:
── TOTP generation - SHA1 - 8 digits - 30s ─────────────────

  Current code        94287082
  Time left           1 seconds (this step runs 1/1/1970, 08:00:30 to 1/1/1970, 08:00:59)
  Next code           37359152
  Reference time      1/1/1970, 08:00:59 · 59 (read as a second timestamp)
  Counter T           1 = floor(59 / 30)
  Key                 GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ (20 bytes - SHA-256 fingerprint 6ED645EF0E1ABEA1BF1E4E935FF04F9E18D39812387F63CDA3415B46240F0405)
  Dynamic truncation  binary=1094287082 → mod 100000000 → 94287082

── Codes inside the window (+/-1 steps) ────────────────────

  offset -1            84755224 · T=0
  offset  0 (current)  94287082 · T=1
  offset +1            37359152 · T=2

── Notes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

- seconds left = (T+1)*period - now = 1s; the code changes the moment it crosses.
- The counter is written to the HMAC as 8 big-endian bytes, so both sides agree as long as the key and the clock match.
- The key is decoded as RFC 4648 base32, ignoring spaces/hyphens and padding.
- The full RFC 6238 vector reproduces with digits=8 + at=<T> (secret=GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ, SHA1, T=59 gives 94287082).

round-trip payload

  Plaintext length            18 bytes

── Notes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

- algorithm/KDF/iterations/salt/IV/authTag all come from the container header and match the mode=encrypt output one for one.

- Only a passing authTag reaches this point; a tampered container or a wrong passphrase stopped one step earlier.
